title: Scooter with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- ground shadow -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="88" rx="40" ry="5" fill="#2a1a4a"/>

  <!-- rear wheel -->
  <circle cx="24" cy="76" r="12" fill="#3a3a5a"/>
  <circle cx="24" cy="76" r="8" fill="#5a5a8a"/>
  <circle cx="24" cy="76" r="3" fill="#8a8aba"/>
  <!-- front wheel -->
  <circle cx="76" cy="76" r="12" fill="#3a3a5a"/>
  <circle cx="76" cy="76" r="8" fill="#5a5a8a"/>
  <circle cx="76" cy="76" r="3" fill="#8a8aba"/>

  <!-- deck / footboard -->
  <rect x="22" y="64" width="56" height="10" rx="5" fill="#ff6b9d"/>
  <rect x="22" y="64" width="56" height="4" rx="2" fill="#ff9dc0"/>

  <!-- deck smiling face -->
  <circle cx="42" cy="69" r="2" fill="#3a1a2a"/>
  <circle cx="54" cy="69" r="2" fill="#3a1a2a"/>
  <path d="M44 71.5 Q48 75 52 71.5" stroke="#3a1a2a" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- steering column -->
  <rect x="72" y="28" width="6" height="38" rx="3" fill="#ffcf3a"/>
  <rect x="72" y="28" width="3" height="38" rx="1.5" fill="#ffe98a"/>

  <!-- handlebar -->
  <rect x="58" y="24" width="24" height="6" rx="3" fill="#ff6b9d"/>
  <rect x="58" y="24" width="24" height="2.5" rx="1.25" fill="#ff9dc0"/>

  <!-- headlight face -->
  <circle cx="70" cy="42" r="10" fill="#ffe98a"/>
  <circle cx="70" cy="42" r="9" fill="#fff4c2"/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <ellipse cx="66" cy="40" rx="2.2" ry="2.8" fill="#2a1a3a"/>
  <ellipse cx="74" cy="40" rx="2.2" ry="2.8" fill="#2a1a3a"/>
  <!-- eye sparkle -->
  <circle cx="65.2" cy="39" r="0.8" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="73.2" cy="39" r="0.8" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d="M64 45 Q70 51 76 45" stroke="#2a1a3a" stroke-width="1.8" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- blush -->
  <circle cx="62" cy="45" r="2" fill="#ffb0c8" opacity="0.9"/>
  <circle cx="78" cy="45" r="2" fill="#ffb0c8" opacity="0.9"/>

  <!-- kickstand -->
  <line x1="40" y1="74" x2="34" y2="86" stroke="#8a8aba" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- little star accents -->
  <circle cx="16" cy="40" r="1.5" fill="#ffe98a"/>
  <circle cx="86" cy="60" r="1.5" fill="#ffe98a"/>
  <circle cx="90" cy="36" r="1" fill="#ff9dc0"/>
  <circle cx="12" cy="60" r="1" fill="#ff9dc0"/>
</svg>
